lubuntu-24.04.name: Lubuntu 24.04 LTS (LXQt)
lubuntu-24.04.notes: Ubuntu Server 24.04.4 autoinstall + lubuntu-desktop, the kvm-lab flavor recipe on plain QEMU. The desktop metapackage is installed by the installer itself (autoinstall packages), sddm gets an autologin drop-in (written for sddm, lightdm and gdm3 alike: the metapackage decides which one lands) for the Lubuntu session and a getty on ttyS0 makes `vmctl console` a login prompt. Expect 30-40 minutes: the metapackage is downloaded during the install.

runcmd: for dm in sddm gdm3 gdm lightdm sddm; do systemctl list-unit-files "$dm.service" >/dev/null 2>&1 && systemctl enable "$dm" && break; done
groupadd -f autologin; groupadd -f nopasswdlogin; usermod -aG autologin,nopasswdlogin {{user}} || true
systemctl enable --now serial-getty@ttyS0.service

ubuntu-gnome-24.04.name: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS (GNOME)
ubuntu-gnome-24.04.notes: Ubuntu Server 24.04.4 autoinstall plus the ubuntu-desktop metapackage: the plain GNOME desktop kvm-lab installs, on the same ISO the five flavour profiles already use. gdm3 gets the autologin drop-in and the user joins the autologin and nopasswdlogin groups; the post-install asserts an active local graphical session, not just an enabled service. Expect 40-50 minutes: ubuntu-desktop is the largest metapackage of the family.

runcmd: for dm in gdm3 gdm lightdm sddm; do systemctl list-unit-files "$dm.service" >/dev/null 2>&1 && systemctl enable "$dm" && break; done
groupadd -f autologin; groupadd -f nopasswdlogin; usermod -aG autologin,nopasswdlogin {{user}} || true
systemctl enable --now serial-getty@ttyS0.service
